title: Detailed lighthouse
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sky glow behind lighthouse -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='28' fill='#1a2a4a' opacity='0.4'/>
  
  <!-- Ground / rocky base -->
  <path d='M12 88 Q20 78 32 82 Q40 76 50 80 Q60 74 70 80 Q80 76 88 88 Z' fill='#4a6741'/>
  <path d='M15 88 Q25 82 35 85 Q45 80 55 84 Q65 80 75 85 Q82 82 88 88 Z' fill='#3d5a35'/>
  
  <!-- Lighthouse base -->
  <rect x='38' y='76' width='24' height='8' rx='1' fill='#d4d4d4'/>
  <rect x='38' y='76' width='24' height='3' rx='1' fill='#f0f0f0'/>
  
  <!-- Main tower body - wider at bottom -->
  <path d='M40 76 L43 40 L57 40 L60 76 Z' fill='#f0f0f0'/>
  
  <!-- Red stripes on tower -->
  <path d='M41.2 68 L58.8 68 L59 62 L41 62 Z' fill='#e63946'/>
  <path d='M41.8 54 L58.2 54 L58.5 48 L41.5 48 Z' fill='#e63946'/>
  <path d='M42.5 44 L57.5 44 L57.6 40 L42.4 40 Z' fill='#e63946'/>
  
  <!-- Tower shading (right side darker) -->
  <path d='M50 76 L57 40 L60 76 Z' fill='#c8c8c8' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Gallery deck / railing -->
  <rect x='39' y='37' width='22' height='3' rx='1' fill='#808080'/>
  <rect x='39' y='37' width='22' height='1.5' rx='1' fill='#a0a0a0'/>
  
  <!-- Railing posts -->
  <rect x='39' y='34' width='1.5' height='3' fill='#808080'/>
  <rect x='48' y='34' width='1.5' height='3' fill='#808080'/>
  <rect x='56' y='34' width='1.5' height='3' fill='#808080'/>
  <rect x='59.5' y='34' width='1.5' height='3' fill='#808080'/>
  <rect x='39' y='34' width='22' height='1' fill='#808080'/>
  
  <!-- Lantern room -->
  <rect x='43' y='24' width='14' height='10' rx='1' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='25' width='12' height='8' rx='1' fill='#ffdd44' opacity='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- Lantern glass panes -->
  <rect x='45.5' y='25' width='2' height='8' fill='#ffee88'/>
  <rect x='52.5' y='25' width='2' height='8' fill='#ffee88'/>
  
  <!-- Lantern glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='29' r='7' fill='#ffee44' opacity='0.3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='29' r='4' fill='#ffee44' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Roof / dome -->
  <path d='M42 24 L50 14 L58 24 Z' fill='#e63946'/>
  <path d='M50 14 L58 24 L50 24 Z' fill='#c03030'/>
  
  <!-- Roof top ball / finial -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='2' fill='#808080'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='12.5' r='1' fill='#a0a0a0'/>
  
  <!-- Lightning rod -->
  <rect x='49.5' y='9' width='1' height='4' fill='#808080'/>
  
  <!-- Door -->
  <rect x='46.5' y='66' width='7' height='10' rx='1' fill='#5a3a1a'/>
  <path d='M50 66 Q53.5 66 53.5 70 L53.5 76 L46.5 76 L46.5 70 Q46.5 66 50 66 Z' fill='#6b4a25'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='71' r='0.8' fill='#ffdd44'/>
  
  <!-- Small window -->
  <rect x='47' y='56' width='6' height='5' rx='1' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='56.5' width='5' height='4' rx='0.5' fill='#ffdd44' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Light beam rays -->
  <path d='M43 28 L20 18 L18 22 L43 30 Z' fill='#ffee88' opacity='0.25'/>
  <path d='M57 28 L80 18 L82 22 L57 30 Z' fill='#ffee88' opacity='0.25'/>
  <path d='M43 30 L22 32 L22 36 L43 32 Z' fill='#ffee88' opacity='0.15'/>
  <path d='M57 30 L78 32 L78 36 L57 32 Z' fill='#ffee88' opacity='0.15'/>
  
  <!-- Stars -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='12' r='1' fill='#aaccff'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='10' r='1' fill='#aaccff'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='25' r='0.8' fill='#aaccff'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='30' r='0.8' fill='#aaccff'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='8' r='0.8' fill='#aaccff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='20' r='0.8' fill='#aaccff'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='40' r='0.6' fill='#aaccff'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='45' r='0.6' fill='#aaccff'/>
  
  <!-- Moon -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='14' r='5' fill='#ddeeff'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='13' r='4' fill='#1a2a4a'/>
</svg>
